profile.headline: Stanford MechE & CS Student
profile.summary:
MS student in Computer Science with an undergraduate background in Mechanical Engineering, and a specialization in mechatronics and control system design. Highly interested in building embedded systems for space exploration, robotics and nuclear fusion technology. Actively seeking full-time employment.

Always open to new opportunities - well-versed in Python, Embedded C, C++, SolidWorks, NX, MATLAB, ANSYS. 
Hit my email: hkim808@stanford.edu

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description: Built automation infrastructure to streamline warehouse flow for precision Falcon, Dragon and Starship components

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Working on mechatronic design and feedback control for a wearable haptic glove that relays tactile feedback in VR through flexible pneumatic actuation. Supervised by Dr. Allison Okamura and Dr. Zhenish Zhakypov of the CHARM Lab

positions.title: Robotics Intern
positions.description: Developing a smarter sensor fusion system

positions.title: Vehicle Engineering Intern
positions.description: Developed in-orbit hardware control algorithms for electric propulsion systems on Starlink Launch 9-12

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description: Worked on avionics, structural components, and propulsion systems for Olympus (IREC competition rocket) and Phoenix (experimental, multi-stage rocket)

positions.title: Alumnus
positions.description:
Participated in the Techstars Incubator (Summer '19 Cohort) through an internship with DASH Systems, a portfolio company. 
Was responsible for fostering connections between VC firms, Techstars Mentors, and engineering employees at DASH Systems. Took notes, organized data and financial models, and helped prep meetings

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Employee #3 and Intern #1! Prototyped a serial comm unit to automate package release from Cessna planes. Wrote a LoRa packet parser to integrate telemetry data with Google Earth engine. Developed a lightweight Python trajectory visualizer from aerodynamic data.

positions.title: Founder, CEO
positions.description:
Founded a nonprofit organization delivering STEM engagement to under-resourced, low-income public schools in the Los Angeles Unified School District. Developed an innovative core curriculum of 3D printing, additive manufacturing, microfluidics, and programming reaching 500+ students. 

Secured $5000+ in funding from online campaigns, school district negotiations, and partnerships with local political campaigns. Subsidized all program costs through said funding
